candidateAbsoluteRule: e8RawCandidateAbsoluteMs = targetMs + ddcParabolicResidualMs; no new inference, peak matching, interpolation or fallback to full
candidateAvailability: Only frozen DDC parabolic candidates; missing remains missing and is incorrect for audible recall and transitions
calibration: E5 opposite-fold same-song unweighted median of raw DDC absolute errors among clear/approximate objects with candidates; minimum 3 pairs, fallback 0 ms
application: e8CandidateAbsoluteMs = e8RawCandidateAbsoluteMs - oppositeFoldCorrectionMs; e8ErrorMs = e8RawErrorMs - oppositeFoldCorrectionMs
primaryMetric: Population-weighted clear+approximate +/-5 ms correct rate using absolute candidate time, including missing candidates as incorrect
coveragePolicy: Report DDC candidate coverage and no-clear output explicitly; calibration itself must not change DDC candidate availability

hypotheses.H1: Calibrated DDC parabolic candidates improve weighted audible +/-5 ms correct rate over E5
hypotheses.H2: Relative to E5, DDC fixes more weighted errors than it breaks and sample-044 remains at least 80%
hypotheses.H3: Every result is deterministic from validated frozen v560 candidates and opposite-fold calibration

testPolicy: Exactly one existing DDC representation and one calibration; no official/parabolic selection after metrics, no full fallback, fusion, rematching, threshold, difficulty or model change
confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels
